rows.text: Section 19 replaces clause 61 of the Constitution: 'The King shall, within 5 days after the appointment of a Prime Minister in accordance with clause 50A following a general election, appoint one of the elected representatives of the nobles on the recommendation of the Legislative Assembly, to be the Speaker of the Legislative Assembly.'
rows.uncertainty: Procedure only. The Act dates no Speaker's selection, appointment or oath, and prints no commencement provision. It is not backdated before the 2010 reform and not read as the procedure in force at any later date without a consolidation check.

rows.text: New clause 61(2)-(4): the Speaker remains in office until the King appoints an Interim Speaker following the next general election under sub-section (8) of the Schedule, until his appointment is revoked under sub-clause (3), or until he dies, resigns or his appointment is revoked after he ceases to be an elected representative of the nobles for any reason other than the dissolution of the Assembly; on the Prime Minister's recommendation with the approval of at least half of the members the King revokes the Speaker's appointment and appoints a new Speaker on the Assembly's recommendation; and the King appoints a Speaker within 7 days of a vacancy.
rows.locator: Section 19, new clause 61(2), (3) and (4), PDF page 12
rows.uncertainty: Procedure only. It is never used to date the end of any Speaker's tenure (for example from a later Interim Speaker's appointment) or to fill a vacancy date.

rows.text: The inserted Schedule (clause 50A) requires the King, within 7 days of the declaration of the result of a general election, to appoint a person who was not a candidate as Interim Speaker, who holds office 'until a Speaker is next appointed under clause 61'; the Interim Speaker invites and receives the nominations for Prime Minister Designate and convenes the ballot, and in any other vacancy in the office of Prime Minister, except after a vote of no confidence, 'the Speaker shall perform the role of the Interim Speaker'.
rows.uncertainty: Procedure only. An Interim Speaker is not a Speaker holder, and no interim appointment is dated by this text.

rows.text: This copy of Act No. 20 of 2010 prints the assent 'I assent, GEORGE TUPOU V, 24th November 2010' and the line 'Passed in the Legislative Assembly this 20th day of July 2010'.
rows.locator: PDF page 5 (assent block); PDF page 15 (passage line)
rows.uncertainty: Enactment metadata of the procedure, not a Speaker event and not a commencement date, so no structured date is stored on this claim. The assent date agrees with the Assembly note already in the packet (to_reform_assent) and the passage date with to_reform_passage.
